subject: Eval pathway — recast MAP, artifacts & escalation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP & proposed evaluation timeline

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the time last week — appreciate the openness around success criteria. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (RWI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) that maps milestones to owners and a proposed 6-week evaluation timeline. High-level notes:

- Week 1: onboarding + network/security review (you own procurement step)
- Weeks 2-3: controlled eval (sample workloads)
- Weeks 4-5: scale test + perf walkthrough with SE
- Week 6: decision meeting & procurement close

Can you confirm whether the procurement checklist you mentioned is already lined up, and whether a SOC2 evidence package will be required prior to the controlled eval? If so, we can shift the start date by 1–2 weeks and provide a re-baseline.

Attaching: RWI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next steps: if the timeline looks OK, I’ll add Rachel (AE) and Karthik (SE) to the MAP so we have owners for each milestone.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acadiahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & proposed evaluation timeline

Monica,

Thanks for the plan — this is helpful. Two items to flag that will push the start date:

1) Procurement: our procurement team needs a completed vendor checklist and a standard contract redline review. They asked me to get a procurement questionnaire back by EOD next week. I’m attaching the checklist we’ll use.
2) Security: our InfoSec has a SOC 2 and network sniff test they run before any environment access. We will need the SOC 2 report and an IP allowlist. That typically adds 7–10 business days.

If we start the onboarding on Aug 17 instead of Aug 3, does that still leave enough runway for the internal stakeholders to evaluate before our fiscal cut-off? We want to avoid running into a quarter boundary if at all possible.

Attaching: Acadia_procurement_checklist.pdf (PDF)

Laura Jensen
Director, Digital Transformation | Acadia Health
laura.jensen@acadiahealth.com | 617-555-0144

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & proposed evaluation timeline

Laura — appreciate the heads up and the procurement checklist.

We can absorb a 2-week shift and still aim for a decision before your fiscal cut-off with one adjustment: compressing the controlled eval to 10 business days and running the scale test in parallel with the security review where feasible. I’ve updated the MAP to reflect an Aug 17 start and compressed timeline — see attached RWI_MAP_v2_rebaseline.xlsx.

Proposed immediate actions:
- I’ll add the SOC2 and IP allowlist requests to the MAP owner column.
- Rachel, can you update the deal timeline and risk log with the new dates and a potential pricing trigger if we slip into the next quarter?
- Karthik, can you prepare a short artifact pack (certs, architecture diagram, minimal access plan) to speed the security review?

If you can confirm procurement’s preferred contract redline owner (legal or procurement), we’ll route the doc ASAP.

Attachments: RWI_MAP_v2_rebaseline.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Monica

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Initial MAP & proposed evaluation timeline

Monica / Karthik —

Updated the risk_log.csv with new timeline (start 2026-08-17) and two key risks: procurement lag and SOC2 evidence timing. Quick notes:

- Risk #1 (probable): Procurement turnaround exceeds 10 business days -> mitigations: pre-fill vendor checklist + legal fast-track.
- Risk #2 (moderate): SOC2 report delivery delays -> mitigations: provide security artifact pack and an isolated test VLAN to reduce InfoSec friction.
- Commercial impact: if decision moves past 2026-08-31 we need to escalate discount approvals (pricing team).

I’ll tag the deal in HubSpot with a 'timeline_recast' property and set a reminder for an executive signal if we hit the 2-week slippage mark.

Attaching: risk_log.csv (CSV)

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: exec signal & artifact one-pager needed

Karthik —

Acadia is asking for the vendor checklist and InfoSec artifacts this week. Procurement is tentatively blocking the contract until they see the checklist and a minimal artifact pack (SOC2, network diagram, admin contacts). Rachel flagged commercial risk if we slip into September. I need an artifact one-pager and a prioritized list of items we can hand off immediately to reduce friction.

Ask: can you produce a 1-page artifact summary plus a zip of the minimal artifacts by EOD Wednesday (Aug 4)? I’ll route the one-pager to Laura and copy our legal for a fast review. Include:
- SOC2 summary (redacted)
- infra diagram (high-level)
- IP allowlist plan
- contact for security questions

Also, include suggested language we can send procurement to accelerate the contract review (e.g., scope-limited SOW, fixed-term evaluation clause). I’m going to mark this as an exec-escalation if we don’t get a hard start date by Friday.

Attaching: artifact_list.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Monica

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Escalation: exec signal & artifact one-pager needed

Monica / Rachel —

I’ve assembled the minimal artifact pack and one-pager. Key contents: SOC2 summary (redacted), infra diagram, IP allowlist template, and an admin contact sheet. I also drafted suggested procurement wording to request a scope-limited evaluation SOW and a 30-day evaluation term — that should reduce legal cycle time.

Two operational proposals to reduce schedule risk:
1) Canary access: provide limited workload access to a small test cohort under an NDA so Acadia can validate functionality earlier without full network onboarding.
2) Parallelized review: while procurement runs contract redline, we can run the controlled eval on a fenced environment (no access to PHI).

Attaching: artifact_pack.zip (archive), canary_playbook.docx (doc)

If you want, I can send the one-pager directly to Laura with the canary proposal and ask procurement if they’ll accept a scoped SOW.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
